name: MAB Compositing with Gaze-Contingent Blending
definition: A compositing technique that maps framebuffer fragments to a Multi-Anchor Buffer (MAB) to retrieve and blend color values from different resolution levels based on gaze distance.
summary: MAB Compositing with Gaze-Contingent Blending is a VR rendering technique that dynamically blends multiple resolution levels based on gaze distance to maintain high frame rates and prevent cybersickness.
